title: uint8
summary: Convert values to unsigned 8-bit integer class.

gpu_support.notes: Real gpuArray inputs use the provider's native integer-cast operation and return resident uint8 storage.

description: `uint8(X)` converts numeric, logical, character, symbolic-constant, and real gpuArray inputs to unsigned 8-bit integer values using saturating rounded conversion.
behaviors: Rounds fractional floating-point values to the nearest integer and clamps the result to the uint8 range.
Converts all eight integer classes directly from native storage without a floating-point intermediate.
Clamps negative values and `NaN` to `0`, and clamps values above `255` to `255`.
Preserves array shape. A complex host input remains complex when its converted imaginary component is zero.
Real gpuArray inputs return provider-owned native uint8 storage; complex gpuArray conversion requires provider support for paired complex-integer storage.

faqs.question: Does `uint8` preserve array shape?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scalar and array inputs retain their dimensions while the numeric class changes to uint8.
